role: The abstract bush base (flowers, tall grass, dead bushes, saplings, mushrooms): a plant with no collision that drops itself and pops when the floor under it can no longer hold it.

members.name: BlockBush
members.note: The plant material, no bounds, no collision.

members.name: canPlaceBlockAt
members.note: blockcb.c:394: the placement path runs the floor test through it.

members.name: func_149854_a
members.note: The floor test, overridden per subclass (sand for dead bush, soil for crops, and so on); blockcb.c:345 names it.

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: blockcb.c:412; the pop is a flags-2 write so nothing is notified (blockcb.c:332).

members.name: updateTick
members.note: The same canBlockStay test with the drop and the removal; randomtick.c:493.

members.name: func_149855_e
members.note: blockcb.c:409 names it; the double plant's override is double_plant_tick in randomtick.c.

members.name: getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool
members.note: Null collision: collide.c's no-box family covers the plant ids.

notes: The subclasses (BlockFlower, BlockTallGrass, BlockDeadBush, BlockSapling, BlockMushroom, BlockCrops, BlockCocoa's host checks) override only the floor test and the drops; each carries its own record. The tallgrass probe (out/java/probes/fe-tallgrass-2) and test_ticks.c exercise the tick path.
